steps.caption: Home
steps.narration: Here is how to get around the CRM: the menu, the page helpers, and dark mode.

steps.caption: The menu
steps.narration: The menu on the left has every part of the CRM, from Home down to Settings.

steps.caption: Fold the menu
steps.narration: This button folds the menu down to icons, to give the page more room.

steps.caption: Open it again
steps.narration: Click it again to bring the names back.

steps.caption: The i
steps.narration: Next to a page's title, the i explains what the page is for.

steps.caption: Close
steps.narration: Press Escape, or the X, to close it.

steps.caption: Clients
steps.narration: Some pages also have a video. Let's open Clients.

steps.caption: Watch
steps.narration: Watch plays a short walkthrough of the page, right here.

steps.caption: Dark mode
steps.narration: The moon at the bottom of the menu switches to dark mode.

steps.caption: Light mode
steps.narration: Click it again to go back to light.

steps.caption: Tutorials
steps.narration: Tutorials, near the bottom of the menu, lists every walkthrough.

youtube.title: How to get around the CRM | ConstructHUB CRM
youtube.description: A short tour of getting around the ConstructHUB CRM. You will fold and open the menu, open a page's i to read what it is for, find the Watch button that plays a walkthrough, and switch dark mode on and off.
